lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance, circular blobs distributed across the mid-flank. The central row exhibits the highest intensity and most regular spacing, with centroids approximately 1.5 to 2 blob diameters apart.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with horizontal carinae to form a grid. High-intensity circular blobs are positioned at the nodes where these vertical bands cross the horizontal ridges.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible. Each ridge is defined by a sharp intensity gradient, transitioning from a light upper edge to a darker shadow-casting lower edge, running parallel from the posterior gill region toward the tail.
